title: Final Work Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the work done W in Joules for the isothermal expansion.

title: Final Temperature Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the final temperature t_f in degrees Celsius after the adiabatic expansion.

title: Use of Ideal Gas Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the ideal gas law correctly in the context of the problem.

title: Adiabatic Process Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the adiabatic process and its implications for temperature change.

title: Logarithmic Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may show correct use of logarithmic properties in calculating W.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may lose points for incorrect signs in the final answers, particularly for temperature.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may lose points for omitting necessary constants or factors in their calculations.
